params.body:
The three proposals of the key scan (#161, #163) put `app/Elixir/Scans/Credentials.php` and `tests/Feature/CredentialsScanTest.php` at the root of the repository instead of under `elixir-app/`: the workbench client took paths relative to a subdirectory and the gateway pushed them as given. The pull requests looked right and the app never saw the file. `hand.mjs` now refuses a root that is not the repository's top level.

This adds the two files where they belong. The two stray copies at the root have to go by hand; the gateway's push cannot delete a file yet:

```
git rm app/Elixir/Scans/Credentials.php tests/Feature/CredentialsScanTest.php
```

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: De sleutelmeting waar de app haar leest: onder elixir-app/
